minimum_launch_tools: Provider route disable and health check
Source artifact and event history inspection
operational_tooling.access_policy: Least privilege, tenant-scoped by default, privileged actions audited.

issue_categories: Website scraper or PDF extraction failure
triage_rules: Treat any cross-tenant access or credential exposure as SEV-1.
Preserve source artifacts and job events before retry or cleanup.
Do not request credentials or secret values through support channels.
Pause systemic failures before replaying work.
Link every production intervention to an auditable incident or support record.

runbooks.title: Recover a stuck import job
runbooks.required_proof: Staging exercise with queue pause, inspection, retry, and terminal outcome.

runbooks.title: Handle a degraded AI provider
runbooks.required_proof: Staging exercise with route disable, fallback/manual mode, and recovery.

runbooks.title: Rollback a release candidate
runbooks.required_proof: Staging rollback of web and worker plus queue/data integrity verification.

runbooks.title: Respond to a tenant-access incident
runbooks.required_proof: Tabletop exercise covering containment, evidence preservation, notification decision, and recovery.

runbooks.title: Recover from object-storage failure
runbooks.required_proof: Staging exercise demonstrating safe retry without data or tenant-boundary loss.

checkpoints: Optional provider configured or manual mode confirmed
First website or PDF source validated
Discovery review and catalog promotion completed
Failure recovery and support path understood

tooling_risks.risk: Launching without tenant-safe operational tools forces direct data or queue manipulation during incidents.
tooling_risks.mitigation: Implement the minimum job, provider, and release operations tools with audited privileged actions.

assumptions.assumption: Private-alpha support can begin with a small named team once auditable tools and escalation channels exist.
assumptions.next_action: Name the team and exercise the support runbooks before invitations.
